US.description: Includes federal income tax, FICA (Social Security and Medicare), and an estimated average state income tax.

IN.description: Includes federal income tax, surcharge, and health and education cess under the new tax regime (FY 2024-25).

SG.description: Includes progressive personal income tax. Does not include mandatory social security contributions (CPF) which are significant.

CH.description: Effective rate including federal, cantonal, and municipal income taxes, plus mandatory social security contributions.

NL.description: Includes income tax and mandatory social security contributions

GB.description: Includes progressive income tax (PAYE) and National Insurance contributions.

CA.description: Includes federal and provincial income taxes (Ontario as representative), plus mandatory contributions for Canada Pension Plan (CPP) and Employment Insurance (EI).

AE.description: No personal income tax is levied on salaries and wages in the UAE for an $85k USD earner.

NO.description: Includes national income tax (trinnskatt), municipal and county income taxes, and social security contributions.

IE.description: Includes income tax, Universal Social Charge (USC), and Pay Related Social Insurance (PRSI).

LU.description: Effective tax rate includes progressive income tax and mandatory social security contributions for a single earner.

AU.description: Includes federal income tax and Medicare levy.

QA.description: No personal income tax is levied on salaries and wages for individuals in Qatar.

BN.description: Brunei has no personal income tax, resulting in a 0% effective tax rate for an $85k USD earner.

MO.description: Includes progressive employment income tax (Professional Tax) with high exemptions, resulting in a low effective rate for most earners.
